tei:div.tei:p: de nas gtor ma la dmigs bya 'gugs pa ni/ na mo/ rig 'jin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'jin rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas stong zhing rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par du rdo rje (840)chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmags tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra khyad par du rig pa 'jin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snga dgra lag gi brdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra thad du 'jug pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad srid pa gsum gyi khongs (841)gar gnas gar bros kyang*/ skad cig yud tsam la dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig traka rak+sha e ka ja ṭī ma ma bh+yoḥ ma hā kā la sha sa naḥ tri badz+ra pā dhu pa ma ya a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kiṅka ra nṛ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha jaḥ jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bya/ ma ma traka rak+sha e ka ja ṭi e daṃ ba liṃ ta pū ja hoḥkha raṃ khā hiḥ oṃ ma hā kā la sha sa na tri ling kiṅka ra e daṃ ba ling+ta pū ja ho:kha raṃ kha hi: tri badz+ra pā (842)dhu pa ma ya e daṃ ba ling+ta pū ja ho:kha raṃ khā hiḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kiṅka ra sa ma ya ba ling+ta bhuñdza ho: zhes zas skal du bsngos la phrin bcol lo//
